sub_indicators.label: Digital accessibility
sub_indicators.subject: include.access
sub_indicators.text: Inclusion of persons with disabilities: digital accessibility
sub_indicators.norm_short: The AU Disability Protocol asks for public information in accessible formats and technologies and for affordable devices; the UN CRPD asks the same of states.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no law or policy addresses access to information or digital services for persons with disabilities.
A government body has drafted, launched or is preparing a law, policy, standard or programme to make information or digital services accessible to persons with disabilities.
A law, regulation, policy or standard in force requires public information, websites or digital services to be accessible to persons with disabilities.
A government body delivered accessible digital services, assistive technology or devices to persons with disabilities, or made public websites or broadcasts accessible.
The results of an audit or survey of how accessible public websites or digital services are to persons with disabilities are published.
